note: Shakedown run. Sourcer was told to prefer candidates whose ingredients already exist in db\ingredients.json. 6 of 9 carry zero unmapped-ingredient flags.

candidates.name: Marry Me Chicken
candidates.why: Iconic viral dish, not in catalog (only Marry Me Pork Chops exists), clean skillet, clears the gate on published numbers.
candidates.selector_note: Minor flavor-adjacency to slow-cooker sun-dried-tomato chicken pastas.

candidates.name: Country Captain Chicken
candidates.why: Distinct cuisine the catalog lacks, curry-braise over rice, all commodities on hand.
candidates.selector_note: Per-serving protein NOT published. Thighs plus bacon make 25g+ near-certain but unverified.

candidates.name: Classic Beef Stroganoff
candidates.why: Whole-muscle stroganoff is absent; catalog has only GROUND beef/pork/turkey stroganoffs, so this is a genuine protein-cut variation.
candidates.selector_note: DUP RISK: shares the stroganoff sauce family with existing ground versions. Source calories exclude the noodles; clears 500 in the catalog's noodle-bowl form.

candidates.name: Chinese Beef and Broccoli
candidates.why: Sliced-steak stir-fry; the catalog's beef-and-broccoli entries are both GROUND, so the whole-muscle version is distinct.
candidates.selector_note: DUP RISK: shares the name with existing entries. Source calories exclude rice; clears 500 as a rice bowl.

candidates.name: Mississippi Pot Roast
candidates.why: Iconic 5-ingredient slow-cooker roast, absent from catalog (has balsamic and French-onion pot roasts, not this). Maps perfectly including ranch/au-jus/pepperoncini board rows.
candidates.selector_note: Sourcer called this the best pure test case: tiny ingredient list, all mapped. Source calories are roast only; over mashed potato or rice it clears 500.
ingredients_verbatim: 1 oz au jus gravy mix (low sodium)

candidates.name: Loco Moco
candidates.why: New cuisine, high calorie and protein, all ingredients mapped.
candidates.selector_note: The per-serving fried egg is assembly-tier, but patty plus gravy plus rice batch cleanly. Catalog already runs egg dishes like Oyakodon.

candidates.name: Chicken Fricassee
candidates.why: Classic French braise absent from catalog; only the wine keeps it off the clean list.
candidates.selector_note: FLAGGED: 1/2 cup white wine is not on the board, omittable by swapping extra broth.

candidates.name: Chicken Florentine
candidates.why: Creamy spinach skillet; catalog has Turkey Florentine Rice Bake but no chicken skillet version. Strong macros.
candidates.selector_note: FLAGGED: 3/4 cup dry white wine, omittable by swapping broth.

candidates.name: Pork Lo Mein
candidates.why: The only pork noodle-stir-fry gap that could be filled cleanly-ish; catalog has Moo Shu, dan dan, ants-climbing, spicy pork noodles but no lo mein.
candidates.selector_note: FLAGGED and weakest of the set: water chestnuts unmapped plus borderline published calories.

sourcer_caveats: Beef Stroganoff and Beef and Broccoli publish sub-500 calories because the source excludes the starch; both clear 500 in the catalog's standard rice/noodle-bowl form.
Country Captain's per-serving protein is not published.
Pork (118) and turkey (141) are extremely saturated; no clean zero-flag pork or turkey candidate was reachable this run.
